messages:
Kaito: Quick RFC follow-up: proposing a "lease_safety_threshold" and a deterministic eviction tie-breaker to avoid oscillation on hot prefixes. Idea: when evicting, prefer demote candidates whose last_access < (now - safety_threshold) OR whose grace_score is lowest. Also include deterministic shard-local ordering so two nodes don't both try to take the same prefix at once.

Elena: Can you clarify grace_score? Is that derived from recent QPS, prefetchbackoff, and pin_count?

Kaito: Yes, grace_score = w1 * recent_qps + w2 * prefetch_inflight + w3 * pin_count. Low score means safe to demote. weights tunable per cluster.

Maya: Sounds reasonable. Two concerns: (1) correctness if a demote occurs while a long-running cursor is active, (2) fairness between tenants.

Kaito: For cursors we add a soft-protection: active_cursor_count > 0 sets pin_count high enough to avoid demote unless forced by global memory-override. For fairness we'll normalize recent_qps by tenant_quota so large tenants don't always win.

Elena: How about the deterministic ordering? We can hash(prefix_id, epoch) mod N to get a stable preferred owner ranking per shard. Then claims respect that ranking during contention windows.

Maya: Hashing is good but make sure epoch changes shuffle the ranking so we can rotate owners intentionally. Maybe include epoch in the salt but only after claim succeeds.

Kaito: Implementation sketch: 1) eviction decision consults safety_threshold and grace_score, 2) candidate list ordered by hash(prefix, lease_epoch) for tie-break, 3) demote issued via CAS updating lease_epoch->epoch+1 and marking demote_ts.

Elena: We need explicit error for callers who hit a demote during write: PREFIX_DEMOTED_WITH_EPOCH, include new_epoch and a recommended_retry_after_ms. Router can use that to re-resolve.

Maya: Also add compaction rule: don't compact tombstones newer than min_active_epoch across cluster for that prefix. Expose min_active_epoch via heartbeats so compactor can be safe.

devops-bot: Suggested metrics: prefix.eviction.attempts, prefix.eviction.denied_by_safety, prefix.demote.errors; recorded -> https://internal/metrics/prefix-evict-safety

Kaito: Testing plan: run a 2-node shard with hotkey generator, enable safety_threshold=2000ms, vary memory pressure. Observe demote rate, client p99, and any stale-write regressions.

Elena: Add a randomized test that flips epoch mid-prefetch to ensure no stale write wins. Also simulate tenant-normalization edgecases.

Maya: I'll own the compaction gating PR. Kaito will prototype eviction ordering. Elena will draft error shapes and router change.

Kaito: Thanks team. I'll post a short spike report in 48h and link a tracking ticket.
